steps.instruction: Wash the vegetables and peel the garlic.
Cut broccoli, carrot, and bell pepper into similar-size pieces.
Heat a little oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Stir-fry carrot and broccoli until just tender, then add pepper.
Add garlic and soy sauce, toss briefly, and serve hot.
Rinse the tomatoes and peel the onion, garlic, and ginger.
Chop the tomatoes and onion; mince the garlic and ginger.
Warm oil in a pan and cook the onion until soft.
Stir in garlic, ginger, and curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas, and water. Simmer until thick.
Taste, adjust seasoning, and serve the curry warm.
Rinse all vegetables under clean running water and drain well.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes; grate the carrot.
Tear the lettuce into bite-size pieces in a large bowl.
Whisk lemon juice with olive oil and salt.
Toss the vegetables with dressing and serve fresh.
